name: cartelclock
title: cartelclock — the deals that decided the 20th century
blurb: eight documented case files on patent pools, price cartels, and government secrecy orders that sped up, slowed down, or rerouted 20th-century technology — radio, light bulbs, rubber, dye, aluminum, aircraft — plus an essay on secrecy culture as the softer enforcement mechanism behind them. @words.bsky.social asked for it.
